bead.title: Document pqueue production deployment readiness contract
bead.description:
Define the release-readiness contract before implementation so every later bead can be checked against a durable artifact. Create or update a deployment readiness document under docs/ that states the production deployment target, supported backends, non-goals, required artifacts, CI gates, release evidence, and explicit S3/object-log boundary.

Current facts to preserve:
- The repo currently has no Helm chart or Kubernetes manifests.
- The repo already has release binaries and Rust/local smoke tests.
- object_log_sqlite_projection is the fjord object-log plus SQLite projection mode; existing evidence validates object-log behavior at the abstraction/local fixture layer, not a provider-specific live cloud S3 deployment.
- The production readiness target for this epic includes Helm install proof in kind for postgres_native and object_log_sqlite_projection, with S3-compatible object storage tested via MinIO if the runtime supports it.

In-scope files:
- docs/**, preferably docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md or an equivalent existing docs location.
- README.md only if it already indexes deployment docs.
Out-of-scope:
- Helm templates, Dockerfiles, workflows, or runtime code changes.
bead.acceptance:
1. `rg -n "production deployment readiness|Helm|kind|postgres_native|object_log_sqlite_projection|MinIO|S3" docs README.md` finds the new readiness contract.
2. `ddx doc validate --no-update-check` passes if available; if that command is unavailable, document the fallback and run `ddx doc audit --no-update-check` or the closest existing doc validation command.
3. `ddx doc stale --no-update-check` reports no stale deployment-readiness document.
